about_the_game:
Story

She came from the East… chasing freedom.
But the Wild West gave her chains.

Young Mei Lin, a girl from China, travels across the ocean and boards a train deep into the untamed American frontier, hoping to find work, peace, and a better life. But fate has cruel plans.

Captured by the infamous outlaw Dirty Bill, Mei Lin is sold to the ruthless owner of a remote saloon — a man known for his cruelty, perversion, and taste for breaking the will of others.

Stripped of freedom, dignity, and hope, Mei Lin must endure the darkest corners of humanity in a savage land where only the strong survive.

Will she escape? Will she be consumed? Or will she become something else entirely?

Features

  • Explicit adult content including non-consensual acts, BDSM, torture, and humiliation

  • Depictions of sexual violence — intended for mature audiences only

  • Racial roleplay and fetish themes

  • Hand-drawn scenes and highly detailed visuals

  • Original soundtrack and immersive audio design

  • A dark and gritty Wild West atmosphere

Viewer discretion is strongly advised.
Not for the faint of heart — this is a brutal tale of domination, survival, and lust on the edge of civilization.
